name: SVC_AI_ENGAGEMENT_METRICS
description: This table stores the AI agent-related events, focusing on agent engagements and associated object details. This table will serve as a foundation for feedback collection.

columns.name: ENGAGEMENT_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: ENGAGEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier for the AI agent engagement.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AGENT_TEAM_CODE
columns.description: Agent team code from FAI_WORKFLOW_B.WORKFLOW_CODE.

columns.name: AGENT_TEAM_VERSION
columns.description: Agent team version from FAI_WORKFLOW_B.WORKFLOW_VERSION.

columns.name: AGENT_CODE
columns.description: Agent code of the Gen AI agent from HR_GEN_AI_AGENTS_B.AGENT_CODE.

columns.name: AGENT_VERSION
columns.description: Agent version of the Gen AI agent from HR_GEN_AI_AGENTS_B.VERSION.

columns.name: SERVICE_WORKFLOW_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_AP_ACTION_PLANS.ACTION_PLAN_ID, the workflow ID if the agent is generated through workflow.

columns.name: OBJECT_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier of the object that this engagement was created for.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the object type of OBJECT_REFERENCE_NUMBER, such as Service Request, Chat, Work Order, Email, etc.

columns.name: JOB_EXECUTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Job execution number from FAI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTIONS.EXECUTION_GROUP_NUMBER that corresponds to Agent Run to track FAI platform.

columns.name: HUMAN_IN_LOOP_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether a human was expected to review/act (vs. silent/fully automated AI invocation).

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_DISPLAYED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the AI Agent's output or recommendation was displayed to the human (agent or end-user).

columns.name: USER_DECISION_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates Accepted, Rejected, Modified, Reviewed, Not Applicable.

columns.name: CONFIDENCE_SCORE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the confidence score, if programmatic comparison tools were used, to be denormalized to accommodate different score types.

columns.name: CONFIDENCE_SCORE
columns.description: Score value related to the confidence score type selected on CONFIDENCE_SCORE_CD.

columns.name: USER_FEEDBACK_RATING
columns.description: Optional feedback rating from the user (1-5).

columns.name: USER_FEEDBACK_COMMENT
columns.description: Free-form text field to capture any comments from user.

columns.name: USER_FEEDBACK_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that stores the feedback from the human user, such as Accurate, Helpful, Needs Improvement, Not Relevant, Incorrect.

columns.name: OUTCOME_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that identifies the type of outcome generated by the AI agent. Some of the possible values are "SR Message", "Action Plan Action", "SR Severity Update", "SR Category Update" and so on.

columns.name: OUTCOME_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the object that was created as an outcome by the AI agent.
